messages:
deploy-bot: starting helm upgrade for release inference-gateway to chart=infra/inference-gateway-chart:3.14.0 in namespace=prod

deploy-bot: ci: https://ci.company/12345 status=passed image=ghcr.io/redwood/inference-gateway@sha256:abcd

alex: rolling this out now. 3.14.0 includes the batching change and new default `max_inflight: 500`

maria: noticed a readiness probe flapping on pod inference-gateway-5c7f8 - cpu jumps then OOMKilled on one replica

sam: can you paste the pod logs?

maria: ```
2026-02-15T10:12:03Z ERROR [worker] kv-cache exhausted
2026-02-15T10:12:04Z WARN  [http] request latency 430ms
2026-02-15T10:12:10Z ERROR OOMKilled
```

alex: hmm — maybe the new default concurrency is too high for the instance type. values.yaml we used:

```yaml
replicaCount: 3
resources:
  limits:
    cpu: "2000m"
    memory: "12Gi"
batching:
  enabled: true
  max_inflight: 500
```

jin: +1 to pinning chart version and reverting `max_inflight` to 100 for prod. We should avoid full rollback unless traffic still affected.

sam: agreed. plan: set image to previous, or update values override and do a canary? we can do a 10% canary by scaling one pod with `helm upgrade --set replicaCount=1 --set replicaSelector=canary` but that's messy.

maria: alternative: helm upgrade with `--set batching.max_inflight=100 --reuse-values` to quickly change value across the release.

alex: if canary isn't automated, I prefer quick values change. Do it now? @oncall-bot can you run a control-plane job to patch HPA if needed?

oncall-bot: @alex I can run the job, but need manual approval. React with :thumbsup: to approve.

sam: :thumbsup: 

alex: approved. executing `helm upgrade inference-gateway infra/inference-gateway-chart --version 3.14.0 --namespace prod --reuse-values --set batching.max_inflight=100`

deploy-bot: helm upgrade started for inference-gateway (3.14.0)

deploy-bot: upgrade complete. STATUS: deployed. 3/3 pods updated.

maria: pods stabilized. no OOMs so far, 95th latency back to baseline.

alex: ok let's pin chart version in our deployment job to 3.13.2 for the next deploy until we validate 3.14.0 changes in staging.

sam: will open a quick PR to pin `chart.version: 3.13.2` in infra/deployments/helm-values/prod.yaml

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/789 - includes note to re-run canary in staging and coordinate with runtime team

deploy-bot: rollback not needed. marking incident: none. tagging release-note: "reverted runtime concurrency default in prod; chart 3.14.0 values adjusted"

jin: postmortem? short note in #postmortems if we want track root cause: change in default config without perf regression testing.

alex: filing short blameless note. action items: (1) add gating e2e for default batching config, (2) run 3.14.0 in staging for 48h, (3) pin prod chart until validated.

maria: thanks all. closing thread.
